title: AUDIT-7 Lane 2 slice 1: adjudicate substantive not_planned closes in developing-today/code
body: 264 issues closed as not_planned since 2026-10-23 were triaged by AUDIT-7 Lane 2 (tracking #13878). ~168 are automation artifacts (78 'do the thing' pm-dispatch placeholders, ~90 scheduled-bot issues, 16 main-broken, 6 preserved-branch decisions). The remaining ~50 substantive code issues (incl. #780,#851,#911,#1006,#1030,#1401,#1466,#1814,#1816,#1825,#1827,#1945,#2350,#2547,#2603,#2641,#2697,#2821,#2846,#2902,#2903,#2991,#3438,#3924,#4300,#4414,#4533,#4722,#4780,#4932,#4980,#5294,#5599,#10402) were closed not_planned with comments that must each be read and adjudicated: reopen with reasons where the close dropped live work, file the correction/follow-up where a gap remains, or record clean with the closing rationale.
